title: Union Church, Hong Kong
scope: The former 1955 Union Church sanctuary, detached granite bell tower, entrance and Kennedy Road retaining terrace as photographed in 2007 before redevelopment.
limitations: The old lot is recorded by the native 2017 map. The exact sanctuary, tower dimensions, step details and rear elevations are estimated from the original 2007 photography and the official building description.
The modeled church is the demolished sanctuary. The 2023 replacement remains separate from the dated model.
